† כָּבוּל n.pr.loc.
1. city on border of Asher Jos 19:27, mod. Kâbûl, 4 h. (9 miles) SE. from Akko, RobBR iii, 88 GuérinGal. i. 422 f.
2. אֶרֶץ כָּבוּל district in Galilee 1 K 9:13 containing 20 cities given by Sol. to Hiram (popular etymol. poss. כּ as + בֻּל = בַּל not, i.e. as good as nothing, cf. v 12, so Ew Th; Klo conject. ארץ גָּלִיל), BuhlGeogr. § 116.
